description.value: West Coast Launch is a family-run marine transport company based in Prince Rupert, operating since 1988, serving Dodge Cove, Digby Island Airport, Metlakatla, Oona River, Kitkatla (a twice-weekly Gitxaała-partnered ferry, Fri 11am / Sun 12pm, $33 adult/$23 senior-child), Lax Kw'alaams, and Gingolx — and, from a second base in Kitimat, Hartley Bay, Kemano, and Kitamaat Village. The company carries general passengers and freight, but no bicycle-specific policy is published — call ahead to confirm.
